root_cause_label: Missing Completion Signal / Harness-Aware Completion Failure
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent implemented a semaphore-based async task runner and verified it with only ad-hoc custom tests, then emitted the completion string via echo rather than triggering the harness-recognized submission mechanism, so the task was never marked resolved.
t_err_evidence: Step 33: agent runs 'echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT' which merely prints the string to stdout; the terminal output shows 'N/A', meaning the harness did not recognize this as a valid completion signal.
t_commit_evidence: Step 33 is the final step and the only completion attempt; since the echo command is not a harness-recognized submission mechanism, the failure is locked in at that same step.
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of how the MiniSWE harness expects task submission to be signaled. Instead of using whatever internal mechanism the harness requires, it simply echoed the completion string as a shell command, which has no effect on the harness evaluation.
